name: exists_labelIdem_eq_off_irreducible
summary: If c is not primitive, P = c. If c is primitive with root xi of order q^r - 1 (r = |n| = 3^(a+1)), the three cubic twists c.scaleRoots(x), x^3 = 1, are pairwise distinct (Frobenius orbits of xi^3 have length r), so one of them avoids S and T; call its character chi (chi^3 = 1) and P = c.scaleRoots(charName chi). By labelChar_mul_det, Xi_P(g) = Xi_c(g) chi(det g). If the coefficients differ at g, then Xi_c(g) is nonzero, so the characteristic polynomial of g is a power Q^j of an irreducible Q (cuspidality); j divides 3^(a+1), and j = 1 is excluded (charpoly reducible) while 3 | j makes det g a cube, so chi(det g) = 1, a contradiction.

steps.claim: Case split on whether IsPrimitiveLabel(|n|, c) holds.
steps.lean:
(labelIdem n c).coeff g = (labelIdem n P).coeff g := by_cases (fun ⟨hc, hi, ξ, hξ,
  h⟩ ↦ have ⟨χ, m, hx⟩ := (reindex_equiv (charName (faithfulChar k))).2.1.1 (by_contra fun _ ↦
    (@Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (rootsOfUnity 3 k) _ _ (c.scaleRoots ·.1 ∈ S) fun x y _ ↦ by
    choose l hl e using exists_pow_card_pow_eq_of_root (hi.map (scaleRootsEquiv _))
      (scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hξ) ((by grind
      [Set.Subsingleton] : c.scaleRoots x.1 = c.scaleRoots y.1) ▸ scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hξ)
    cases frobenius_conj_pow_injOn 1 hq (hr ▸ h) prime_three (by simpa [scaleRootsEquiv, hc.2,
      hr] using hl) Fin.pos'
      (by simpa [mul_pow, ← map_pow, (mem_rootsOfUnity' ..).1] using (e ▸ pow_right_comm _ 3 _ :))
    aesop (add simp [IsLabel, aeval_def])).not_gt (by
    erw [IsCyclic.card_powMonoidHom_ker, Nat.card_units, gcd_eq_right (by lia)]; simp) :
    ∃ x ∈ rootsOfUnity 3 k, c.scaleRoots x ∉ _)
  ⟨_, (⟨·.scaleRoots _ congr($m) hq, hx⟩), fun g _ ↦ .symm (by_contra fun z ↦ by
  simp_all [MulEquiv.map_eq_one_iff, ← map_pow, ← labelChar_mul_det hc, mul_right_eq_self₀,
    labelIdem, IsLabel.scaleRoots, hc.1]
  choose P j i p using isCuspidal_greenTau.exists_charpoly_eq_pow z.1.2
  obtain ⟨⟨_ | _⟩⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow prime_three).1 ⟨_, by simpa [hr] using congr(natDegree $p)⟩,
    g.det_ne_zero <;> simp_all [Matrix.det_eq_sign_charpoly_coeff, pow_add, pow_mul',
    coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, ← χ.pow_apply', MulChar.one_apply])⟩) (⟨c, ·.elim, by simp⟩)

steps.claim: There is a multiplicative character chi of k whose name charName(faithfulChar k, chi) in k^x is a cube root of unity, with c.scaleRoots(charName chi) not in the union of S and T: through the bijection charName between characters of k and k^x this is the existence of a cube root of unity x in k with c.scaleRoots x outside S and T, proved by contradiction below.

steps.claim: Suppose c.scaleRoots x lies in S or T for every cube root of unity x in k. Then the map x -> [c.scaleRoots x lies in S] from the group of cube roots of unity of k to the two truth values is injective, so that group has at most 2 elements. For injectivity let x, y be cube roots of unity with the same value.
steps.lean:
(@Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (rootsOfUnity 3 k) _ _ (c.scaleRoots ·.1 ∈ S) fun x y _ ↦ by
    choose l hl e using exists_pow_card_pow_eq_of_root (hi.map (scaleRootsEquiv _))
      (scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hξ) ((by grind
      [Set.Subsingleton] : c.scaleRoots x.1 = c.scaleRoots y.1) ▸ scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hξ)
    cases frobenius_conj_pow_injOn 1 hq (hr ▸ h) prime_three (by simpa [scaleRootsEquiv, hc.2,
      hr] using hl) Fin.pos'
      (by simpa [mul_pow, ← map_pow, (mem_rootsOfUnity' ..).1] using (e ▸ pow_right_comm _ 3 _ :))
    aesop (add simp [IsLabel, aeval_def]))

steps.claim: Since S and T have at most one element each, c.scaleRoots x = c.scaleRoots y. This polynomial is irreducible (the image of c under scaleRootsEquiv) and has the roots x xi and y xi; so y xi = (x xi)^(q^l) for some l < deg c = |n|.
steps.lean:
choose l hl e using exists_pow_card_pow_eq_of_root (hi.map (scaleRootsEquiv _))
      (scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hξ) ((by grind
      [Set.Subsingleton] : c.scaleRoots x.1 = c.scaleRoots y.1) ▸ scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hξ)

steps.claim: Cubing and using x^3 = y^3 = 1 gives (xi^3)^(q^l) = xi^3 = (xi^3)^(q^0). The powers (xi^3)^(q^i), 0 <= i < 3^(a+1), are distinct (9 | q - 1, xi primitive of order q^(3^(a+1)) - 1, 3 prime), so l = 0; then x xi = y xi and x = y.
steps.lean:
cases frobenius_conj_pow_injOn 1 hq (hr ▸ h) prime_three (by simpa [scaleRootsEquiv, hc.2,
      hr] using hl) Fin.pos'
      (by simpa [mul_pow, ← map_pow, (mem_rootsOfUnity' ..).1] using (e ▸ pow_right_comm _ 3 _ :))
    aesop (add simp [IsLabel, aeval_def]))

steps.claim: This contradicts the count of cube roots of unity: k^x is cyclic of order q - 1 and 3 | q - 1, so the kernel of x -> x^3 has gcd(3, q - 1) = 3 > 2 elements.
So some cube root of unity x in k has c.scaleRoots x outside the union of S and T (the statement proved by the contradiction).

Take P = c.scaleRoots(charName chi): if c is a primitive label of degree |n|, so is P (scaling by the cube root of unity charName chi, with 3^2 = 9 dividing q - 1), and P is not in the union of S and T.
Let g in GL_n(k) have a characteristic polynomial that is not irreducible, and suppose the coefficients of labelIdem(n, P) and labelIdem(n, c) at g differ; derive a contradiction.
steps.lean:
fun g _ ↦ .symm (by_contra fun z ↦ by
  simp_all [MulEquiv.map_eq_one_iff, ← map_pow, ← labelChar_mul_det hc, mul_right_eq_self₀,
    labelIdem, IsLabel.scaleRoots, hc.1]
  choose P j i p using isCuspidal_greenTau.exists_charpoly_eq_pow z.1.2
  obtain ⟨⟨_ | _⟩⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow prime_three).1 ⟨_, by simpa [hr] using congr(natDegree $p)⟩,
    g.det_ne_zero <;> simp_all [Matrix.det_eq_sign_charpoly_coeff, pow_add, pow_mul',
    coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, ← χ.pow_apply', MulChar.one_apply])⟩)

steps.claim: Unfolding labelIdem (both c and P are labels of degree |n|) and Xi_P(g) = Xi_c(g) chi(det g) (labelChar_mul_det, with Xi_P(1) = Xi_c(1)), the difference of the two coefficients is Xi_c(1)/|GL_n(k)| times the conjugate of Xi_c(g)(1 - chi(det g)); as it is nonzero, Xi_c(g) is nonzero and chi(det g) is not 1.
steps.lean:
simp_all [MulEquiv.map_eq_one_iff, ← map_pow, ← labelChar_mul_det hc, mul_right_eq_self₀,
    labelIdem, IsLabel.scaleRoots, hc.1]

steps.claim: Xi_c is Green's class function of the irreducible c, which is cuspidal; as it does not vanish at the class of g, the characteristic polynomial of g is Q^j for an irreducible polynomial Q.
steps.lean: choose P j i p using isCuspidal_greenTau.exists_charpoly_eq_pow z.1.2

steps.claim: Comparing degrees, j deg Q = |n| = 3^(a+1), so j = 3^i. If i = 0 the characteristic polynomial Q is irreducible, against the assumption on g. If i >= 1, det g = +-(constant term of Q^j) is a cube up to the sign (-1)^|n| (|n| odd), so chi(det g) = 1 because chi^3 = 1 (det g nonzero), against step 1.1.3.1.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨_ | _⟩⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow prime_three).1 ⟨_, by simpa [hr] using congr(natDegree $p)⟩,

steps.claim: Case c not primitive: P = c; part (1) holds vacuously and part (2) trivially.
